purpose: Replace failed intent-utility preservation with direct teacher-blind proposition-to-proposition redundancy certification. Residual evidence may displace a baseline proposition only when the removed baseline proposition is independently aligned to another retained baseline proposition on the same source page.

exclusion_evidence.implication: Author-framed salience can discover complementary residual evidence but standalone replacement displaces established source-aware coverage.
One-shot balanced set coverage does not preserve the strong source-aware control.

Preserving source-aware intent utility is not a sufficient proxy for preserving semantic evidence: the zero-loss selector fell from 7/13 control support to 6/13 while its intent-utility constraint passed on all papers.

research_evidence.source: Ernst et al., The Power of Summary-Source Alignments, Findings ACL 2024
research_evidence.evidence: Summary-source alignment is more precise at proposition-span granularity than sentence-level heuristics and can support salience/redundancy tasks.
research_evidence.implication: Preservation should operate on the exact proposition units already used by EXTRACT rather than on aggregate query utility.

research_evidence.source: Ernst et al., Proposition-Level Clustering for Multi-Document Summarization, NAACL 2022
research_evidence.evidence: Paraphrastic proposition clustering is used to identify repeated information and reduce redundancy more cleanly than sentence-level clustering.
research_evidence.implication: A baseline proposition may be removable only when another proposition independently carries substantially overlapping information.

research_evidence.source: Suhara and Alikaniotis, Source Identification in Abstractive Summarization, EACL 2024
research_evidence.evidence: Similarity-based source-identification methods are reported as robust in relatively extractive settings.
research_evidence.implication: A similarity-based preservation certificate is reasonable for exact extracted propositions before introducing a learned semantic judge.

research_evidence.source: Ge et al., Extractive Summarization via Fine-grained Semantic Tuple Extraction, INLG 2024
research_evidence.evidence: Fine-grained semantic units can be used as coverage targets rather than relying on fixed sentence counts.
research_evidence.implication: Semantic-tuple preservation is a credible later family, but it adds an IE/model dependency and is deferred until a zero-model proposition-alignment premise is tested.

source_only_calibration.metric: For each baseline proposition, maximum research_engine.local_extract_wave1.token_f1 against any other baseline proposition on the same source page.
source_only_calibration.interpretation: The 0.40 certificate is deliberately sparse and source-only. It identifies a high-overlap redundancy tail without imposing a fixed number of residual slots. Runtime selection never reads teacher atoms or teacher support.

architecture_families.mechanism: Dynamic proposition-to-proposition token-F1 redundancy certification on the same authoritative PDF page; residual swaps may consume only independently certified redundant baseline slots.
Extract predicate-argument semantic tuples and preserve tuple coverage before residual augmentation.
architecture_families.reason: Scientifically attractive but adds an information-extraction dependency before the simpler proposition-alignment premise is tested.

architecture_families.mechanism: Use a learned proposition paraphrase/entailment model to certify redundancy.
architecture_families.reason: Would require a new model/download and transfer validation; not justified before a zero-model alignment diagnostic.

architecture_families.mechanism: Reserve a fixed number of low-ranked source-aware slots for residual evidence.
architecture_families.reason: The 20/4 arm is prior non-verdict evidence and may not be promoted or tuned post hoc.

selected_first_diagnostic.purpose: Test whether direct same-page proposition redundancy certificates can expose residual capacity while retaining all frozen source-aware teacher support.
inputs: exact valid Wave 7A.3 generated-intents artifact SHA256 a5a970725c1f16a694633416ad9fbd98e58418c267891ac83b7783d8af218ebd
frozen source-aware BM25 RRF top-24 as baseline
frozen author-anchored BM25 residual RRF only as a fixed residual candidate ordering
same nine-paper authoritative PDFs, selected-page proposition pool, BM25 per-intent depth 12, RRF k=60, and final budget 24

algorithm.residual_order: author-anchored BM25 RRF order; baseline propositions are skipped
algorithm.certificate_source: another proposition from the original frozen baseline set that is still retained
algorithm.page_preservation: the set of source pages present in the frozen baseline top-24 may not shrink
algorithm.removal_order: among currently certified removable baseline propositions, remove the one with worst frozen source-aware fusion rank; tie-break proposition_id
algorithm.addition_order: take the highest-ranked residual RRF proposition not already selected
algorithm.stop_rule: stop when no certified removable baseline proposition remains or no residual candidate remains

controls: predeclared fixed 20-control/4-residual quota as non-verdict reference only

ALIGNMENT_AUGMENT_STRONG: recovers both observed residual atoms e1.a and e6.a
retains all 7/7 frozen source-aware control-supported atoms
merged-page recall is at least 90% of the frozen coarse selected-page ceiling
every removal has a live same-page baseline alignment certificate >=0.40 and page preservation passes
ALIGNMENT_AUGMENT_FEASIBLE: retains all 7/7 frozen source-aware control-supported atoms
merged-page recall is at least 90% of the frozen coarse selected-page ceiling
ALIGNMENT_AUGMENT_NEGATIVE: neither STRONG nor FEASIBLE is met

decision_boundary.if_strong_or_feasible: Only then design a second-stage semantic generalization of the certificate (semantic tuples or learned paraphrase/NLI) as a separate evidence-first contract; do not change production routing yet.
decision_boundary.if_negative: Reject sparse lexical proposition alignment as an adequate semantic-preservation certificate and return to a materially different evidence-unit representation.
decision_boundary.never: Do not promote/tune the fixed 20/4 quota, change the 0.40 threshold after teacher results, execute the rejected Qwen gap judge, train/download a classifier, start Wave 7B, alter production EXTRACT/VERIFY, or introduce ontology/semantic-control mechanisms.

next_safe_action: CI-lock this design checkpoint. Then implement DYNAMIC_SAME_PAGE_ALIGNMENT_SWAP_V1 exactly as frozen, add deterministic unit tests for certificate scope/dynamic recomputation/page preservation/verdict gates, run normal CI, durable-checkpoint the implementation, and issue exactly one zero-generation diagnostic.
